detail.longDescription: Amazon Web Services (AWS) as part of deprecating email certificate verification wants me to add CNAME records to the DNS at SquareSpace for friendsofbrooklyn.org and www.friendsofbrooklyn.org . But I do not have a www.friendsofbrooklyn.org in my list of domains at SquareSpace. I added both CNAMES to the firendsofbrooklyn.org DNS entry but only the friendsofbrooklyn.org entry gets verified by AWS. I do not know how to proceed as this is one of those one-off things that I have zero experience with and I hope someone can offer a way forward. I am open to adding the www domain to SquareSpace or modifying AWS so that it does not require a www CNAME entry. There is a CNAME record at SquareSpace with name www and data d2714alnjx3zx7.cloudfront.net; that is the domain name listed on the Cloudfront main page.
